path.description: The file, resolved through renames to its current path.

guideline.description: Guideline for the relative change in complexity, first sample to last. The direction label is worsening or improving at or beyond it. The measured ratio is in the summary.

complexitySource.description: Historical blobs are always measured with the indentation proxy: a complexity report describes one commit only.

revisions.description: Logical changes that left the file with content, in all usable history.

samples.description: Revisions spread evenly over the file's history, oldest first, always including the first and the last.

commit.description: The commit that wrote the sampled blob.

path.description: The file's path in that revision.

complexity.description: Indentation complexity. Null for a binary file.

lines.description: Lines in the file. Null for a binary file.

direction.description: From the first sample's complexity to the last. Insufficient with fewer than two samples or no measurable complexity.

changeRatio.description: Relative change in complexity, last sample against first. A zero first sample with a non-zero last is 1. Null when either is not measurable.

guideline.description: The relative change that the direction label is given at.

peak.description: The sample with the highest complexity, so a spike between the first and last samples is visible. Null when no sample is measurable.
